source.title: Quantitative live-cell imaging of GPCR downstream signaling dynamics
source.authors: Tany R, Goto Y, Kondo Y, Aoki K
source.changes: Images were segmented and measured by scripts/build-hela-erk-ktr.py; the images themselves are not bundled. Values are background-subtracted means; no smoothing, no normalisation.

specimen.reporters: nuclear marker (RFP channel), ERK-KTR (iRFP channel), DORA-RhoA (CFP and FRET channels)
specimen.note: These are the cells of the live-cell experiment. They are not the cell of the electron-microscopy volume.

readout.name: ERK-KTR cytoplasm / nucleus
readout.meaning: Rises when ERK phosphorylates the reporter and it leaves the nucleus.
readout.resolution: Two regions per cell (nucleus, a perinuclear cytoplasmic ring) from wide-field images at 0.74 µm per pixel. Nothing finer is supported.

rules.nucleusThreshold: 0.5 × Otsu threshold of the smoothed marker image (σ = 1 pixel)
rules.cellThreshold: background + 4 background standard deviations of the smoothed DORA-RhoA image
